about_the_game:
Step into the front office and take total control of your favorite football franchise in Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 26. This is the ultimate pro football simulation experience—designed for fans who want the depth, strategy, and freedom that other games overlook.

Build your dynasty from the ground up. Manage every detail of your team’s journey—from drafting the next superstar, negotiating key contracts, and scouting opponents, to setting weekly gameplans and making the tough calls on game day. Smart AI ensures every season feels fresh and competitive, while enhanced presentation brings your franchise to life like never before.

New for DDS: Pro Football 26, enjoy expanded customization, refined player progression, and deeper in-game strategy options. Whether you’re a master roster-builder or a sideline strategist, you’ll find countless ways to put your mark on the league.

Key Features:

  • True Franchise Mode Focus – Draft, trade, sign, and develop players while managing the salary cap and long-term team building.

  • Smarter AI & Realistic Gameplay – Challenge yourself against AI that adapts and creates unique league storylines every season.

  • Deep Customization – Easily edit teams, players, logos, and leagues to create your own perfect football universe.

  • Immersive Game Day – Call plays, adjust strategies, and watch your vision unfold on the field with enhanced presentation.

  • Endless Replayability – Every save tells a different story, ensuring no two careers are ever the same.

If you’re a football fan who loves the strategy, decision-making, and drama of running a franchise, Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 26 is your game. Build your legacy. Rewrite the record books. Become the ultimate GM.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: XP/Vista/Win7/Win8.X/Win10/Win11
  • Processor: Intel or AMD 64 bit
  • Graphics: 1920x1080 display capable of running 32-bit color or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: XP/Vista/Win7/Win8.X/Win10/Win11
  • Processor: Intel or AMD 64 bit
  • Graphics: 1920x1080 display capable of running 32-bit color or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
